subject: Nanotechnology
title: Quantum Dot Solar Cells
description: Learn Quantum Dot Solar Cells in one minute.

hook.text: Tune a quantum dot's size and change which color of sunlight it absorbs — one material, infinite bandgaps.

buildup.text: Colloidal QDs are printed onto flexible substrates — creating solar cells cheaply from a liquid ink.

discovery.text: Multiple exciton generation lets one photon create two electron-hole pairs — potentially exceeding the Shockley-Queisser limit.

twist.text: Surface defects trap charges before extraction — passivation chemistry is critical to efficiency and stability.

climax.text: QD solar cell efficiency reached 18.1% in 2023 — approaching commercial viability after years of lab progress.

punchline.text: Print tiny dots on a sheet and harvest sunlight at any color.

quiz.question: What is multiple exciton generation in quantum dot solar cells?
options: One photon creates two or more electron-hole pairs, potentially exceeding standard efficiency limits
Multiple photons combine to excite one electron to a higher state
Excitons from adjacent dots merge into a stronger current
